findings.claim: The zero-durable-write assertion only observes writes to single-segment settings paths, so a write to a nested settings path (e.g., /api/uar/settings/provider/{key}) would bypass interception, escape the durableSettingsWrites ledger, and fall through to the real server — silently passing the 'no durable write occurs' assertion.
findings.evidence: The route regex is `/\/api\/uar\/settings\/(?:types|[a-z-]+)(?:\?.*)?$/` — `[a-z-]+` cannot match a path segment containing `/`, and `page.route` handlers that don't match fall through to the network without failing the test. Constraint `keyboard-and-draft-preservation` names "zero-write assertions" as its validation method, and the final `expect(durableSettingsWrites).toEqual([])` is the sole enforcement.
findings.suggested_fix: Broaden the pattern to cover the whole settings namespace (e.g., `/\/api\/uar\/settings(?:\/.*)?$/`) and/or add a catch-all `page.route(/\/api\//, route => route.abort())` so any unmocked API request — especially any mutation — fails loudly instead of passing through.

findings.claim: The visible-focus assertion can false-pass: it accepts any computed `boxShadow !== "none"` on the control without comparing pre-focus versus post-focus styles, so a control with a static decorative box-shadow and no focus treatment would satisfy the "visible focus" requirement of constraint `keyboard-and-draft-preservation`.
findings.evidence: `expectVisibleKeyboardFocus` computes `hasOutline || focusStyle.boxShadow !== "none"` from a single post-focus snapshot; there is no baseline capture of the control's box-shadow/outline before focus to prove the indicator is focus-triggered.
findings.suggested_fix: Capture the control's computed outline/box-shadow before focusing, then assert a measurable change after focus (or assert the `:focus-visible`-specific ring token), so the assertion demonstrates a focus indicator rather than ambient styling.

findings.claim: The artifact header records "Generated: 2026-08-27T07:53:29Z" (the iteration-1 timestamp) while the body reports iteration-2 outcomes (old-layout negative control, strengthened Tier 3 pass at 3.5s, iteration-1 review disposition), so the provenance timestamp misstates when the documented evidence was assembled.
findings.evidence: `state.json` records iteration 2 at 2026-08-27T08:06:06Z and `refinement_log.md` iteration 2 describes the negative control and strengthened Playwright run that the summary documents, yet the summary's "Generated" line predates them. Constraint `truthful-phase-evidence` governs accurate recording of receipts.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate or re-date the summary at the iteration-2 timestamp (or add an explicit "Updated" line) so the artifact's provenance matches its contents.

findings.claim: The "Verification requirements" section contains a dangling numbered list (items 1–11) appended after the per-task evidence paragraphs rather than preceding them as requirements, indicating a paste/assembly artifact that obscures which statements are requirements versus recorded results.
findings.evidence: In the execution.md hunk, the "## Verification requirements" section first carries dated Task 1.1–3.3 evidence paragraphs and then a bare `1.`–`11.` imperative list (e.g., "Before React edits, record the required Impeccable...", "Run `pnpm typecheck`...") with no heading separation.
findings.suggested_fix: Reorder so the numbered requirements precede the dated evidence, or move the numbered items under their own heading.
